description: Shows paying member subscriptions and monthly recurring revenue (gross and net) for the team's branded app, with 30- and 90-day change. Use when the user asks how many members pay, what the app earns per month, or how revenue is trending. Not for workout engagement (use get_content_analytics). Returns current totals and trend deltas; daily points go to the widget only.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

title: Get branded app revenue
